target_customer: Health tourism clinics (dental) serving UK patients
problem: Clinics selling treatment abroad lacked accurate patient health data such as dental scans before quoting.
business_model: Per patient onboarding fees from clinics (not confirmed)

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly operations: local guides and dental scanning, with simple web tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Guide network and clinic relationships could be copied easily by clinics or existing medical travel agencies.

market_need_then: UK dental patients traveling to Turkey and elsewhere; ONS later showed UK residents treated abroad rose from 234,000 to 431,000 between 2021 and 2023 (a later figure, not as of founding).

branding.domain_note: uselobby.com (prefix domain); now parked for sale on GoDaddy

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word and no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Lobby was a one person London company aiming to onboard UK patients for health tourism clinics through licensed guides who collect dental scans. No funding, press or post mortem was found and the website is now parked for sale. The cause is not public; the failure factors are speculative and rest on its single founder team and thin traction.
notes: Website now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page (dead). Competitor list empty: searches found only undated pages and later items. YC page cites both $200B and $270B market size without explanation. Founder background not found; a directory said identity link to other records is unconfirmed. Failure factors are inferred.
